description: When businesses may place sales and automated calls, by US federal rule, US state, US territory, Canadian federal rule and Canadian province. Windows are [start, end) in the called party's local time unless fixed_zone is set. Days run 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday.
disclaimer: Informational, not legal advice. Laws change and courts interpret them; confirm with a lawyer licensed in the jurisdiction before relying on any rule here.
generated: Generated by the export script from the rule source. Do not edit by hand; propose changes as described in CONTRIBUTING.md.

call_types.sales_live: A telephone solicitation or telemarketing call placed by a person.
call_types.sales_automated: A sales call that uses an autodialer, a prerecorded message, or an artificial or AI-generated voice (FCC 24-17 treats AI voices as artificial voices under the TCPA).
call_types.automated_non_sales: An autodialed, prerecorded or AI-voice call that sells nothing, such as reminders, notices and surveys.
call_types.live_non_sales: A person calling about anything other than a sale.

rules.title: TCPA calling hours (FCC rule)
rules.scope: Telephone solicitations to residential subscribers, including wireless numbers, by any person or entity.
rules.quote: No person or entity shall initiate any telephone solicitation to: (1) Any residential telephone subscriber before the hour of 8 a.m. or after 9 p.m. (local time at the called party's location)

rules.title: Telemarketing Sales Rule calling hours (FTC rule)
rules.scope: Outbound telemarketing calls to a person's residence, without that person's prior consent.
rules.quote: Without the prior consent of a person, it is an abusive telemarketing act or practice ... to engage in outbound telephone calls to a person's residence at any time other than between 8:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m. local time at the called person's location.

rules.title: Alabama PSC telephone solicitation rule
rules.scope: Automated (s.1) and live (s.2) solicitation calls to consumers in Alabama.
rules.holiday_note: The rule bans calls on "holidays" without listing them. Call Desk treats every federal holiday as banned; Alabama-only state holidays are not computed.
rules.quote: No solicitation calls are allowed on Sundays or holidays. On the days that calls are allowed, none will be placed prior to 8 a.m. or after 8 p.m.

rules.title: California automatic dialing-announcing device hours
rules.scope: Automatic dialing-announcing devices (prerecorded or artificial voice messages) calling phones in California, for any purpose, when the device is operated in California. Schools, tax-exempt organizations calling members, utilities and emergency agencies are exempt (2872(d), (e)). Pub. Util. Code 2874 also requires a live natural-voice introduction before the message plays.
rules.quote: A person shall not operate an automatic dialing-announcing device in this state to place a call that is received by a telephone in this state during the hours between 9 p.m. and 9 a.m. California time.

rules.title: Connecticut telephonic sales call hours
rules.scope: Telephonic sales calls (live, autodialed, recorded, soundboard, text or over-the-top message) to a Connecticut resident or a Connecticut area code.
rules.effective: P.A. 23-98 s.13, effective 2023-10-01; amended by P.A. 24-75
rules.quote: shall be limited to being conducted between the hours of nine o'clock a.m. and eight o'clock p.m. local time.
notes: "Conducted between" reads as the whole call falling inside the window: finish before 8:00 p.m.

rules.title: Florida Telemarketing Act calling hours
rules.scope: Commercial telephone sellers and salespersons under the Florida Telemarketing Act, including automated or recorded calls. Fla. Stat. 501.604 lists broad exemptions.
rules.frequency_cap: No more than 3 commercial telephone solicitation calls to a person within 24 hours on the same subject matter, from any number (501.616(6)(b)).
rules.effective: Added by ch. 2021-185, Laws of Florida
rules.quote: A commercial telephone solicitation phone call before 8 a.m. or after 8 p.m. local time in the called person's time zone.

rules.title: Illinois Automatic Telephone Dialers Act hours
rules.scope: Autodialers playing a recorded message, operated in Illinois. Live calls fall under 815 ILCS 413/15, which matches the federal window.
rules.quote: No person shall operate an autodialer in this State to place a telephone call during the hours between 9 p.m. and 9 a.m.

rules.title: Kentucky telephone solicitation hours
rules.scope: Telephone solicitations to a person's residence by telephone or interconnected VoIP.
rules.quote: Making telephone solicitations to a person's residence at any time other than between 10 a.m. - 9 p.m. local time, at the called person's location

rules.title: Louisiana ADAD and live solicitation hours
rules.scope: Automatic dialing-announcing devices or live operators used to sell, lease or give away consumer goods or services, or to conduct polls.
rules.holiday_note: The statute bans "days declared to be a state holiday". Call Desk treats every federal holiday as banned; Louisiana-only holidays such as Mardi Gras are not computed.
rules.quote: (2) Such use is other than between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m., Monday through Saturday. (3) Such use is on days declared to be a state holiday, or Sundays.

rules.title: Massachusetts telephone solicitation hours
rules.scope: Unsolicited telephonic sales calls to an individual Massachusetts consumer about consumer goods. Excludes calls the consumer requested, existing debts or contracts, and existing customers.
rules.quote: (ii) to be received between the hours of 8:00 p.m. and 8:00 a.m., local time, at the consumer's location

rules.title: Maryland Stop the Spam Calls Act hours
rules.scope: Telephone solicitations, including calls made through automated dialing or a recorded message.
rules.frequency_cap: No more than 3 telephone solicitations to a called party within 24 hours on the same subject matter, from any number (14-4502(c)(2)).
rules.effective: Stop the Spam Calls Act of 2023
rules.quote: A person may not make or cause to be made a telephone solicitation, including a call made through automated dialing or a recorded message: (1) To a called party during the hours between 8 p.m. and 8 a.m. in the called party's time zone

rules.title: Maine automated solicitation call hours
rules.scope: Automated telephone calling devices making solicitation calls (sales, charitable solicitation or surveys) to any number in Maine. Sub. 2 separately restricts these calls to residential and cell numbers.
rules.frequency_cap: One completed solicitation call per telephone number per 8-hour period.
rules.effective: Sub. 3 from PL 1991 c. 524; section as amended by PL 2019 c. 185
rules.quote: A person may not use an automated telephone calling device to make solicitation calls to any telephone number in the State except weekdays between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., according to the time in this State
notes: Covers automated calls only when they are solicitation calls, which includes surveys and charitable solicitation; a pure reminder or notice is outside it.

rules.title: Minnesota ADAD and commercial solicitation hours
rules.scope: Any use of an automatic dialing-announcing device, and any commercial telephone solicitation to a residential subscriber with no prior relationship.
rules.quote: A caller shall not use an automatic dialing-announcing device nor make any commercial telephone solicitation before 9:00 a.m. or after 9:00 p.m.

rules.title: Mississippi Telephone Solicitation Act hours
rules.scope: Telephone solicitations to consumers in Mississippi.
rules.citation: Miss. Code Ann. 77-3-723(1), as amended by HB 1350 (2024)
rules.quote: Such calls may only be made between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. Central Standard Time. No telephone solicitations may be made on a Sunday.
notes: The statute fixes Central Standard Time (UTC-6) all year, so during daylight saving time the window is 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. Central Daylight Time.
Read from the official enrolled bill text on the Mississippi Legislature site; the compiled code is hosted by Lexis.

rules.title: Mississippi unsolicited telephonic sales call hours
rules.scope: Unsolicited telephonic sales calls to residential numbers in Mississippi.
rules.quote: Make calls between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m., Central Standard Time, Monday through Friday, and between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m. on Saturdays (no calls shall be made on Sundays)

rules.title: Nebraska PSC ADAD rule
rules.scope: Automatic dialing-announcing devices delivering a solicitation or advertisement to a residential line. The statute alone (Neb. Rev. Stat. 86-248) matches the federal window.
rules.holiday_note: Legal holidays get the Sunday window, 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Call Desk applies it on every federal holiday; Nebraska-only holidays are not computed.
rules.citation: 291 Neb. Admin. Code ch. 11, 003.01; Neb. Rev. Stat. 86-248(1)(a)
rules.quote: between the hours of 8:00 AM and 9:00 PM, Monday through Saturday, and between the hours of 1:00 PM and 9:00 PM, Sunday and legal holidays. All times indicated are local times of the party called.

rules.title: Nevada automatic dialing and announcing device hours
rules.scope: Automatic dialing and announcing devices (random or sequential number generators used to play a prerecorded sales message) calling phones in Nevada. Preexisting business relationships and the NRS 597.816 exemptions are excluded.
rules.quote: A person shall not operate a device for automatic dialing and announcing to place: (a) A call that is received by a telephone located in this State during the period between 8 p.m. and 9 a.m.

rules.title: Oklahoma Telephone Solicitation Act hours
rules.scope: Commercial telephone sellers and salespersons, including automated or recorded calls.
rules.frequency_cap: No more than 3 commercial telephone solicitation calls to a person within 24 hours on the same subject matter, from any number.
rules.quote: A commercial telephone solicitation phone call before 8 a.m. or after 8 p.m. local time in the called person's time zone

rules.title: Oregon telephone solicitation hours
rules.scope: Telephone solicitations by live call or text. Excludes business-to-business calls, charities calling members or donors, polling, and replies. An established business relationship (a transaction within 18 months) lifts both the hours rule and the cap.
rules.frequency_cap: No more than 3 separate solicitations to a party within 24 hours.
rules.citation: ORS 646.563(1)(b), as amended by Or. Laws 2025, ch. 580 (HB 3865), s.2
rules.quote: The person initiates a telephone solicitation outside the hours of 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. or initiates a solicitation more than three separate times to a party within a 24-hour period, unless the person has an established business relationship

rules.title: Oregon automatic dialing and announcing device hours
rules.scope: Automatic dialing and announcing devices delivering a prerecorded or synthesized voice or text message to a residential or wireless subscriber, for any purpose. Excludes established business relationships, debt collectors, schools and public safety.
rules.frequency_cap: No more than 3 calls to a subscriber within 24 hours.
rules.citation: ORS 646A.372(5), as amended by Or. Laws 2025, ch. 580, s.4
rules.quote: A caller that uses an automatic dialing and announcing device may use the device to call a subscriber only between the hours of 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. and may not call the subscriber more than three times in 24 hours.

rules.title: Pennsylvania Telemarketer Registration Act hours (Act 47 of 2026)
rules.scope: Telephone solicitations (calls, voicemail, ringless voicemail and texts) to residential, business or wireless subscribers for consumer goods or services. Excludes prior express written consent, an existing debt or contract, and an established business relationship within 12 months.
rules.citation: 73 P.S. 2245(a)(1) (Telemarketer Registration Act s.5(a)(1)), as amended by Act of July 20, 2026, P.L. 532, No. 47 (SB 992)
rules.quote: Initiating or causing to be initiated a telephone solicitation on a Sunday or after 7 p.m. or before 9 a.m.
notes: Before 2026-10-18 the Pennsylvania rule was 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. with no Sunday ban, the same as the federal window.

rules.title: Rhode Island telephonic seller hours of operation
rules.scope: Only "telephonic sellers" and their salespersons as defined in R.I. Gen. Laws 5-61-2 (a narrow class including prize or gift offers and precious metals pitches). Ordinary sellers outside that definition fall under the federal window.
rules.holiday_note: Bans "a state or federal holiday" on weekdays. Federal holidays are computed; Rhode Island-only holidays such as Victory Day are not.
rules.effective: P.L. 1999, ch. 456; definition amended P.L. 2005, ch. 36 and 72
rules.quote: "Hours of operation" means Monday through Friday, except a state or federal holiday, nine o'clock (9:00 a.m.) to six o'clock (6:00 p.m.); Saturday ten o'clock (10:00 a.m.) to five o'clock (5:00 p.m.).

rules.title: South Dakota telemarketing hours
rules.scope: Unsolicited consumer telephone communications (calls or texts) by a telemarketer to a residence. Excludes calls the person requested, existing debts or contracts, existing business relationships, and newspapers.
rules.quote: Place unsolicited consumer telephone communications to any residence which will be received before 9 a.m. or after 9 p.m. at the consumer's local time or place any unsolicited consumer telephone communications on Sunday

rules.title: Texas consumer telephone call hours
rules.scope: Unsolicited calls to a residential number to sell consumer goods or services or extend credit. Excludes calls at the consumer's request, existing debts or contracts, and prior business relationships.
rules.quote: the telephone solicitor makes the call after 12 noon and before 9 p.m. on a Sunday or after 9 a.m. and before 9 p.m. on a weekday or a Saturday

rules.title: Texas automatic dial announcing device hours
rules.scope: Automatic dial announcing devices delivering recorded telephone solicitations that terminate in Texas.
rules.quote: (1) before noon or after 9 p.m. on a Sunday; or (2) before 9 a.m. or after 9 p.m. on a weekday or a Saturday.

rules.title: Utah Telephone and Facsimile Solicitation Act hours
rules.scope: Telephone solicitations (commercial or donation calls or messages) to residential or cellular phones without prior express consent.
rules.holiday_note: Bans calls on "a legal holiday". Federal holidays are computed; Utah-only holidays such as Pioneer Day are not.
rules.quote: A person may not make a telephone solicitation to a residential telephone or cellular telephone without prior express consent during any of the following times: (a) between the hours of 9 p.m. and 8 a.m. local time; (b) on a Sunday; or (c) on a legal holiday.

rules.title: Washington telephone solicitation hours
rules.scope: Telephone solicitations: unsolicited calls by commercial or nonprofit organizations.
rules.effective: 8 p.m. cutoff from 2022 c 195 s 1; last amended 2023 c 103 s 3
rules.quote: A telephone solicitor shall not place calls to any person which will be received before 8:00 a.m. or after 8:00 p.m. at the call recipient's local time.

rules.title: Washington commercial telephone solicitor hours
rules.scope: Commercial telephone solicitors under the Washington Commercial Telephone Solicitation Act (RCW 19.158).
rules.quote: A commercial telephone solicitor shall not place calls to any person which will be received before 8:00 a.m. or after 8:00 p.m. at the call recipient's local time.

rules.title: Wyoming telephone solicitation hours
rules.scope: Unsolicited telephonic sales calls to consumers about personal, family or household goods or services, live or automated.
rules.quote: No telephone solicitor shall initiate any unsolicited telephonic sales call to a consumer before the hour of 8 a.m. or after 8 p.m. local time at the consumer's location.

rules.title: CRTC Telemarketing Rules calling hours
rules.scope: Telemarketing telecommunications to consumers in Canada, including business consumers and registered charities. Calls made only for emergencies, account collection, surveys or market research are outside the Telemarketing Rules (Part III s.6).
rules.citation: CRTC Unsolicited Telecommunications Rules, Part III (Telemarketing Rules), s.23
rules.effective: Telecom Decision CRTC 2007-48, as amended; page dated 2014-03-31
rules.quote: a telemarketing telecommunication is restricted to the following hours: 9:00 a.m. to 9:30 p.m. on weekdays (Monday to Friday); and 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on weekends (Saturday and Sunday).
notes: The hours are the called consumer's local hours.
Telemarketing by ADAD (a prerecorded or synthesized voice) also needs the consumer's prior express consent for that specific number (Part IV s.2).
crtc.gc.ca blocks automated readers; the text was read from the Internet Archive snapshot of the official page dated 2026-10-01.

rules.title: CRTC ADAD Rules calling hours
rules.scope: Calls in Canada using an automatic dialing-announcing device (a prerecorded or synthesized voice message) where no solicitation is made. Calls for public service reasons by police, fire, schools and hospitals are exempt (s.4(i)).
rules.citation: CRTC Unsolicited Telecommunications Rules, Part IV (ADAD Rules), s.4(b)
rules.quote: such telecommunications are restricted to 9:00 a.m. to 9:30 p.m. on weekdays (Monday to Friday) and 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on weekends (Saturday and Sunday); the hours refer to those of the person receiving the telecommunication

rules.title: British Columbia Telemarketer Licensing Regulation
rules.scope: Licensed telemarketers in British Columbia calling consumers. A supplier calling consumers for its own transactions is exempt from licensing (s.2(1)) unless the calls are distance sales contracts or solicit contributions for another supplier.
rules.holiday_note: Bans calls on every holiday in the Interpretation Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 238, s.29, except a holiday that is only Sunday. Call Desk computes them: New Year's Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Easter Monday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, BC Day, Labour Day, the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation, Thanksgiving, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day and December 26.
rules.frequency_cap: No more than one contact per 30 days about the same proposed consumer transaction, unless the consumer asks (s.8(3)).
rules.citation: Telemarketer Licensing Regulation, B.C. Reg. 83/2005, s.8 (Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act)
rules.quote: A licensee must not communicate or attempt to communicate with a consumer by telephone or facsimile (a) on a statutory holiday,

no_stricter_rule_found.note: AS 45.50.475 has no hours rule; (a)(4) bans automated or recorded solicitation calls outright.
C.R.S. Title 6 has no time-of-day rule.
D.C. Code 22-3226.08(3): 8 a.m. to 9 p.m., the federal window.
6 Del. C. ch. 25A has no calling hours.
Iowa Code 714D has no hours rule.
MCL 445.111a to 445.111c and 484.125 have no hours rule.
MCA 30-14-1602 has no hours rule; MCA 45-8-216 bans automated recorded sales calls unless a live operator gets permission first.
R.C. ch. 4719 has no hours rule.
Wis. Stat. 100.52 and ATCP 127 have no hours rule.
W. Va. Code 46A-6F-601(a)(4): 8 a.m. to 9 p.m.
